copy_detector.echo_frac_where_human_acted_def: of the 951 windows where the human's own speed departed from v0 by >= 0.5 m/s RMS, the fraction on which the arm nevertheless stayed within 0.1 m/s of v0. The discriminating subset: holding was demonstrably the wrong answer and the arm held anyway.
